# Alba Wellbeing

> Alba Wellbeing is Lina Simavičiūtė (known as Alba), a medically trained, self-employed live-in carer based in Louth, Lincolnshire, who takes live-in placements anywhere in England. She lives with the person she cares for in their own home, offering personal care, companionship, rehabilitation support and end-of-life companionship, with optional hypnotherapy, therapeutic massage, Reiki and breathing sessions. The first conversation is free; fees are agreed individually.

Key facts:
- Who: Lina Simavičiūtė, known as Alba. Originally from Lithuania, permanent right to live and work in the UK. Speaks English, Lithuanian and Russian.
- Experience: five years of care in UK homes. Medically trained and professionally qualified. Self-employed (arranged directly, not through an agency). References available on request. Full driving licence.
- Conditions supported: dementia, Parkinson's disease, stroke, cancer, Down syndrome, reduced mobility, complex care needs, palliative and end-of-life care.
- Area: anywhere in England (she moves in with the person cared for). Home base: Louth, Lincolnshire. Hypnotherapy online anywhere in the UK, or in person near Louth.
- Not provided: regulated nursing or medical treatment. Lina works alongside GPs, district nurses and hospice teams.
- Contact: +44 7300 403632 (call or text), albalinasima25@icloud.com
- Motto: Professional knowledge. Human presence. A happy we.

## Services

- [Live-in care and companionship](https://www.albawellbeing.co.uk/live-in-care.html): what live-in care is, what Lina helps with, conditions, costs (agreed individually) and FAQs
- [Short-term live-in care to build healthy routines](https://www.albawellbeing.co.uk/short-term-live-in-care.html): Lina lives in for an agreed period, often around three months, and helps the person build a daily routine (meals, gentle exercise and physiotherapy exercises, sleep, medication on time, getting out, relaxation), then writes it down and hands it over to the family. Aim: independence. Follows the advice of GP, dietitian and physiotherapist; not a dietitian or physiotherapist herself
- [End-of-life and palliative companionship](https://www.albawellbeing.co.uk/end-of-life.html): companionship at home and respite for families, alongside GP, district nurses and hospice
- [Hypnotherapy and wellbeing sessions](https://www.albawellbeing.co.uk/hypnotherapy.html): hypnotherapy for anxiety, stress, sleep and confidence; therapeutic massage, Reiki, breathing

## Areas covered in England

Lina takes live-in placements anywhere in England. Each region has its own page with the towns covered and the journey from Louth:

- [Live-in carer in Lincolnshire](https://www.albawellbeing.co.uk/live-in-care/lincolnshire.html): home county; Louth, Lincoln, Grimsby, Skegness, Boston, Grantham
- [Live-in carer in Yorkshire and the Humber](https://www.albawellbeing.co.uk/live-in-care/yorkshire.html): Hull, York, Leeds, Sheffield, the Dales and the coast
- [Live-in carer in North East England](https://www.albawellbeing.co.uk/live-in-care/north-east.html): Newcastle, Durham, Sunderland, Teesside, Northumberland
- [Live-in carer in North West England](https://www.albawellbeing.co.uk/live-in-care/north-west.html): Manchester, Liverpool, Lancashire, Cheshire, Cumbria
- [Live-in carer in the East Midlands](https://www.albawellbeing.co.uk/live-in-care/east-midlands.html): Nottingham, Derby, Leicester, Northampton, Peak District
- [Live-in carer in the West Midlands](https://www.albawellbeing.co.uk/live-in-care/west-midlands.html): Birmingham, Coventry, Black Country, Staffordshire, Shropshire, Herefordshire
- [Live-in carer in the East of England](https://www.albawellbeing.co.uk/live-in-care/east-of-england.html): Norfolk, Suffolk, Cambridgeshire, Essex, Hertfordshire, Bedfordshire
- [Live-in carer in London](https://www.albawellbeing.co.uk/live-in-care/london.html): every London borough
- [Live-in carer in South East England](https://www.albawellbeing.co.uk/live-in-care/south-east.html): Kent, Sussex, Surrey, Hampshire, Berkshire, Oxfordshire, Buckinghamshire, Isle of Wight
- [Live-in carer in South West England](https://www.albawellbeing.co.uk/live-in-care/south-west.html): Bristol, Bath, Gloucestershire, Wiltshire, Dorset, Somerset, Devon, Cornwall
